recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a man with curly hair leaning against a large, rusted industrial gear. The scene is bathed in warm, sun-drenched light with a soft-focus outdoor background. The composition features a double-exposure effect in the lower third, layering gear silhouettes over the subject's arm and the main text block.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point in the upper right quadrant.
Rusted gear acting as a curved framing device on the left.
Text anchored in the lower third, partially obscured by a gear-pattern overlay.
Warm, golden-hour lighting connecting the subject to the rustic environment.
coreInvariants: Warm, yellow-green color cast across the entire image.
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Industrial, weathered textures contrasting with soft skin tones.
Double-exposure gear motif in the foreground.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's head is positioned in the upper right, scaled to fill approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large rusted gear on the left provides a heavy, dark anchor that balances the light-filled face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's gaze, moves down the curve of the gear, and settles on the horizontal text block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Soft-focus greenery in the upper left and right provides breathing room around the head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and golden-yellow tones in the highlights and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and rusted oranges in the mechanical elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the primary typography to ensure legibility against the dark background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a heavy yellow-green tint; high value contrast between the sunlit face and shadowed gear.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical Roman serif for the primary line; elegant italic serif for the secondary line.
letterConstructionRules: Open counters in the display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, authoritative Roman serif paired with a delicate, flowing italic for a balance of strength and intimacy.
graphicDevices: Double-exposure gear silhouette overlaying the bottom section.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classical, timeless feel of the display text.
Matches the elegant, traditional feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with curly hair leaning on a large rusted iron gear outdoors. Use warm, golden-hour lighting with a yellow-green tint. The background should be a soft-focus green forest. Apply a semi-transparent overlay of gear silhouettes in the bottom third.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a large white Roman serif font in all caps, left-aligned in the lower third. Add the subtitle in a smaller, cream-colored italic serif font, right-aligned below the primary text.

verificationChecks: Does the color cast feel warm and rustic?
Is the gear silhouette overlay present in the lower third?
Is the primary text in a high-contrast serif font?
Is the subject's face the clear focal point?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the yellow-green color tint
Opacity of the gear silhouette overlay
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact rust patterns on the gear
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the double-exposure effect doesn't make the text illegible.
Check that the warm tint doesn't wash out skin tones completely.
Verify the serif fonts maintain a classic, non-modern appearance.
Confirm the composition follows the rule of thirds for the face and gear.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic industrial foreground element with a warm-toned portrait, using a double-exposure texture overlay in the lower third to anchor classical serif typography.
